attachments.origin_landmark: medial epicondyle (+ ulnar head at coronoid)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Two heads (humeral, larger; ulnar, smaller) sandwich the median nerve between them -- pronator teres syndrome's classic entrapment site.
functional_compartments.source: Holzbaur KR, Murray WM, Delp SL (2005) Ann Biomed Eng 33(6):829-840 -- upper-extremity muscle architecture model (fascicle length, pennation, PCSA)

motor_endplate_zones.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology
motor_endplate_zones.notes: Nerve-dense region of the ulnar head. Its centre of highest muscle-spindle abundance sits in the UPPER third of that region, at 31.23% of muscle length. The source recommends prioritising the radial nerve-dense region when only one site is injected. The atlas models pronator teres as a single compartment; the source maps its ulnar and humeral heads separately, so both sets are recorded here and distinguished by label.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Zhou J, Jia F, Chen P, Zhou G, Wang M, Wu J, Yang S, 'Localisation of the centre of the highest region of muscle spindle abundance of anterior forearm muscles', J Anat 244(5):803-814 (2023), doi:10.1111/joa.14000 -- 24 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology and spiral CT localisation

motor_endplate_zones.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology
motor_endplate_zones.notes: Nerve-dense region of the humeral head, which begins more proximally than the ulnar head's. Its centre of highest spindle abundance sits in the LOWER third, at 30.13% of muscle length -- so the two heads' optimal points nearly coincide in level even though their nerve-dense regions do not. The atlas models pronator teres as a single compartment; the source maps its ulnar and humeral heads separately, so both sets are recorded here and distinguished by label.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Zhou J, Jia F, Chen P, Zhou G, Wang M, Wu J, Yang S, 'Localisation of the centre of the highest region of muscle spindle abundance of anterior forearm muscles', J Anat 244(5):803-814 (2023), doi:10.1111/joa.14000 -- 24 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology and spiral CT localisation

injection_target_points.label: ulnar head
injection_target_points.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology, localised by spiral CT with barium sulphate labelling
injection_target_points.notes: SURFACE NOT ESTABLISHED. The source places all but one of its eleven projection points on the anterior forearm and one on the posterior forearm, but the label identifying the exception was lost in full-text extraction, so `depth_measured_from` is omitted here rather than guessed. The three percentages are unaffected; confirm the surface against the paper's CT localisation figure before planning a needle path from the depth figure.

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: Transverse on the volar forearm, 2-3 cm distal to the elbow crease, on the radial side; the muscle lies medial to the radial cortex.
ultrasound_injection_approach.depth_layer: Superficial flexor layer, with flexor carpi radialis immediately medial to it.
ultrasound_injection_approach.identification_cues: Pronator teres appears round -- a 'ball' -- with flexor carpi radialis alongside it shaped like a 'shark', the pair described as a shark eating a ball. Two heads, humeral and ulnar, are separated by an intramuscular fascia.
structures_at_risk: median nerve (passes between the two heads)
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: Injected to restore supination in the triple-flexion pattern. The paper's strategy deliberately spares biceps brachii and brachioradialis, which supinate, and injects brachialis instead as the only pure elbow flexor.
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Diaconu S et al. (Elias University Hospital), 'A Visual Guide to Ultrasound-Guided Botulinum Toxin Injection in Spasticity: Part I -- Distal Upper Limb Muscles', Toxins 17(3):107 (2025), doi:10.3390/toxins17030107
